name: Dozzle Self-Hosted Docker Log Viewer
free_limit: MIT-licensed self-hosted real-time container log viewer for Docker, Docker Swarm, Kubernetes and Podman; free forever with no vendor-imposed log-viewing quota or account requirement.
watch_out: Live log viewer, not a long-term log archive. Requires your own container host; Docker socket access is privileged and must be secured. Hosting and storage costs are separate.
